[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Dorlin''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]] and resident of [[Kessan's Landing]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. During the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Mantellian uprising]], she became concerned about unstable seismic readings which could potentially threaten Kessan's Landing. She asked an individual to collect more accurate readings from areas that were too dangerous for her to traverse, which they did so. With this new data, she realized that the seismic activity was less concerning than she previously believed, but resolved to keep an eye on it nonetheless.<ref name="TOR:UR"/>
